Rule responses recorded from a Cumulocity tenant on 2026-11-24 with
go-c8y-cli (GET /service/dataprep/v1/rules and /v1/rules/{name}/deployed).
The user is replaced, the smart function code and the test list are
shortened, and a "thermo" rule with a failed deployment was added to
rules_list.json to cover that state.

run_tests_response.json follows the example in the published OpenAPI
specification, with an extra failing test.
